title: Pictograms / Expressive size progression

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: Expressive

slide_intent: Check expressive detail across sizes, because a symbol’s fine lines and gradient relationships must remain readable as its footprint changes.
strategic_value: A consistent size progression can help IBM’s expressive pictograms retain their character across applications.
demonstration: The same currency-like expressive symbol appears five times from left to right, labeled 64px,80px,96px,128px and 160px.
practical_value: Compare the five shown sizes when choosing a prominent pictogram for the available space.

content_islands.name: Type selector
content_islands.spec: Show Expressive selected in the tab row.

content_islands.name: Size progression
content_islands.spec: Align five versions on a shared horizontal band, increasing from 64px to 160px and retaining each size label.

reference_purposes.Expression: The repeated symbol preserves black detail and blue-cyan gradient strokes across the five sizes.
reference_purposes.Application: The labeled progression provides a direct size comparison.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The accompanying sizing guidance sets a general pictogram minimum of 48px and directs original sizes or accepted increments; this expressive example begins at 64px and does not independently establish a 64px minimum.
